title: Chang-Chen six-body zw-diagrams (117), machine-readable
paper: K.-M. Chang and K.-C. Chen, Toward finiteness of central configurations for the planar six-body problem by symbolic computations, arXiv:2303.02853v1 (6 Mar 2023, 117 pp.); journal versions: (I) J. Symbolic Comput. 123 (2024) 102277, doi:10.1016/j.jsc.2023.102277; (II) SIAM J. Appl. Dyn. Syst. 24(3) (2025) 2369-2404, doi:10.1137/24M1716070.
numbering: Diagram numbers are those of arXiv:2303.02853v1 (Figures 3-6, pp. 72-75; Sec. 11, pp. 54-71) and of the authors' notebook. The journal versions were not accessible (paywall / Cloudflare); the SIADS abstract gives the same counts (86 after Algorithms I+II, at most 85, 61 with mass relations, so 24 left) but whether it keeps the numbering 1..117 is NOT verified.
vertex_labels: bodies 1..6 as in the paper; in the figures vertex k sits at angle 2*pi*(k-1)/6 (1 right, then counterclockwise).
symmetry: The 117 are classes of zw-matrices (A|B) modulo simultaneous relabelling of bodies (all 720 permutations of S6) AND exchange of the two colours (A|B) -> (B|A). Source: Sec. 6, Step (I.4), p. 36 ("remove all duplicated matrices up to permutations of bodies and the exchange of z and w"), and the notebook duplicate test, which compares {A[p,p],B[p,p]} and {B[p,p],A[p,p]} for every permutation p. Checked here: the 117 are pairwise inequivalent under S6 x Z2; 19 are self-dual under the colour exchange (up to S6), so they represent 117 + 98 = 215 classes under S6 alone. Representatives satisfy tr(A) <= tr(B) (z-circles at most as many as w-circles) and, for the z-matrix, circled bodies have the larger indices.

status_legend.mass_relation: 61 diagrams impossible unless the masses satisfy a polynomial relation (codimension 1 in mass space; the arXiv v1 says "co-dimension 2", the SIADS abstract says "co-dimension 1")

mu_notation.mu_15, mu_21, mu_33, mu_45, mu_84, mu_88: long factors (subscript = number of terms), Appendix IV pp. 111-116

selection_notation: "(i1,...,ik; j1,...,jl)" = main equations z_{i1},...,z_{ik}, w_{j1},...,w_{jl} used in the elimination (Table 2 caption, p. 57). C2_size = |C_2|, the number of Type-2 zw-order matrices produced by Algorithm II (Tables 2-3).
